title: Monotonicity of density expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $F,G:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $F(x)\le G(x)$ for every $x$. Then the expectation of $F$ under $\varphi$ is at most the expectation of $G$ under $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$
